basic_details.job_title: TMC TMC Fellow in Molecular Pathology Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

The fellowship is a tenured position for a fixed period up to one year with a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,33,623/-, and it needs an M.D./D.N.B. (Pathology) or equivalent NMC-recognised postgraduate degree with one

how_to_apply: Open the online application on the Tata Memorial Centre website through the careers link given in the notice: https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers.
Complete the prescribed online application form in all respects; incomplete applications will be rejected.
Submit documentary evidence for the details furnished in the form, including proof of date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste/category, disability certificate and NOC, wherever applicable.

If you are currently employed in a Government or Government-related organisation (Central/State Government, Autonomous Body or Semi Government Organisation), upload a No Objection Certificate issued through the Head of your Institution/Department.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 300/- online, unless you belong to an exempted category.
Submit the application by 15 November 2026, up to 05.30 p.m. (IST). A separate application must be submitted for each post.

Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to cancel the post or increase/decrease the number of advertised posts. content_sections.heading: TMC Varanasi Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre – Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Varanasi
Fixed period up to One Year
One-Year TMC Fellow in Molecular Pathology

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The fellowship is open to Indian Nationals who meet the following requirements. All undergraduate, postgraduate and super-specialty degrees must be recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Experience is counted as on 15 November 2026. Candidates whose results are awaited may apply, where applicable, but must produce proof of having passed the required degree at the time of the MCQ/Interview. Those who cannot produce this proof will not be permitted to appear for the MCQ/Interview. The maximum age limit is 45 years, reckoned as on 15 November 2026. The age limit is relaxable as per applicable rules: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.post: One-Year TMC Fellow in Molecular Pathology
rows.essential_qualification: M.D./ D.N.B. (Pathology) OR equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by NMC
rows.experience: One year experience in Onco Pathology

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Fellow will be offered a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,33,623/- (Rupees One Lakh Thirty-Three Thousand Six Hundred Twenty-Three only). The post is a tenured position for a fixed period up to one year. The notice also prescribes a Security/Caution Deposit of Rs. 1,33,623/- for the Fellow. All candidates selected and appointed to HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, must be registered with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online using Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. The fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

rows.category: SC / ST / Female Candidates / Persons with Disabilities / Ex-servicemen (1st time applying for civil post after serving any rank)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Varanasi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application on the Tata Memorial Centre website through the careers link given in the notice: https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers . Complete the prescribed online application form in all respects; incomplete applications will be rejected. Submit documentary evidence for the details furnished in the form, including proof of date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste/category, disability certificate and NOC, wherever applicable. If you are currently employed in a Government or Government-related organisation (Central/State Government, Autonomous Body or Semi Government Organisation), upload a No Objection Certificate issued through the Head of your Institution/Department. Pay the application fee of Rs. 300/- online, unless you belong to an exempted category. Submit the application by 15 November 2026, up to 05.30 p.m. (IST). A separate application must be submitted for each post. No other mode of application will be accepted, and candidates are not required to submit or send a hard copy of the application form. Provide your latest mobile number and a valid e-mail ID, because all correspondence will be made through the e-mail ID [email protected] . The Centre will not be responsible for communications lost due to online submission errors, incorrect e-mail IDs or e-mails delivered to spam/bulk folders.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview, and an MCQ examination may be conducted before the interview for shortlisting. Whether the MCQ is held is at the discretion of the Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, whose decision is final. Tata Memorial Centre reserves the right to prescribe minimum eligibility standards/benchmarks and to restrict the number of candidates called for the MCQ/interview, based on factors including the number of vacancies and the performance of candidates. The Centre may prescribe minimum eligibility standards or cut-off marks, including Groups/Stream/Discipline/Category-wise cut-offs, for shortlisting for the interview and for final selection after the interview. Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not give an applicant any right to be called for the MCQ Test/Interview. Employed candidates must produce the original NOC at the MCQ test/Interview; failure to do so will result in the candidate being disallowed from appearing. No TA/DA (Travel Allowance / Dearness Allowance) will be admissible to candidates appearing for the MCQ/interview. The decision of the Director, HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, in this regard is final and no representation will be entertained. The date of the MCQ examination or interview is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TMC Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of One-Year TMC Fellow in Molecular Pathology in the Department of Onco Pathology for HBCH and MPMMCC, Varanasi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the TMC Varanasi Fellowship?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 15 November 2026, up to 05.30 p.m. (IST).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the TMC Fellow in Molecular Pathology post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.D./D.N.B. (Pathology) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognised by NMC, and one year of experience in Onco Pathology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the TMC Varanasi Fellowship?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years as on 15 November 2026, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the TMC Fellow in Molecular Pathology?
faq.answer: The Fellow will get a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,33,623/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 300/-, paid online by Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI; SC, ST, female, PwD and eligible ex-servicemen candidates are exempted, and the fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for TMC Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply only through the online application at https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers by 15 November 2026; no hard copy needs to be sent.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are selected through an interview, and an MCQ examination may be conducted before it for shortlisting at the discretion of the Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi.

faq.question: Q9. Is the TMC Varanasi Fellowship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a tenured position for a fixed period up to one year.

faq.question: Q10. Is a security deposit required for the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prescribes a Security/Caution Deposit of Rs. 1,33,623/- for the Fellow.
